title: General.
officialText:
Ventilation shall be provided for rooms, buildings and enclosures in which Class I liquids are pumped, used
or transferred. Design of ventilation systems shall consider the relatively high specific gravity of the vapors. Where natura l
ventilation is used, adequate openings in outside walls at floor level, unobstructed except by louvers or coarse screens, shall be
provided. Where natural ventilation is inadequate, mechanical ventilation shall be provided. The natural ventilation design shall
be approved for each specific application by the commissioner prior to installation and/or use.
